title: The Wise Woman of Abel-Beth-Maacah
description: The city of Abel-Beth-Maacah is besieged by Joab's army because of Sheba's rebellion against King David. A wise woman negotiates with Joab and convinces the inhabitants to cut off Sheba's head to save the city from destruction [ref:2 Sam 20:14-22|2 Samuel 20:14-22].
